scope: Pinned source review and proposal reuse choice; no native package execution or bank acceptance
steps: Authenticate cutoff commit/tree and selected source blobs; separate inherited mutable metadata from exact source identity.
Inspect prediction, blocking, training, pair probability and clustering contracts, rights, dependencies and persistence.
Derive and reproduce small linkage/selection/cluster/cost examples; preserve uncertainty and business clock.
Choose reference/integrate/port/defer/reject with alternative, owners, cost denominator and native qualification triggers.
Integrate connected monograph and sponsor discussion preserving prior evidence; review source, arithmetic, all-page text/bounds; record exact continuation.
risks: Blocking may exclude true links; candidate-pair quality is not full-population recall.
Pairwise scores and connected components do not establish joint entity truth or causal validity.
Training and matching features may include post-treatment information.
Selected static code does not establish cross-engine equivalence, native runtime, privacy or price.

findings: No external bank-data input needed for proposal-level review.
Exact authored examples are distinguished from runtime measurements.
Preserve failed acquisitions; collector restoration is mandatory.
Do not repeat inherited README acquisition as if sufficient technical evidence.
Only source/proposal artifacts may change until canonical predecessor release completes.
